note: The Creative Mode pilot brief banks (docs/CREATIVE_MODE_PLAN.md §10) with the EXPECTED-ROUTE table (§11). expectedRoute is what a correct router decides under the given mode: 'adapt' | 'create' | 'either' (genuinely defensible both ways - never counted as a routing failure). catalogAnchor names the catalog structure an 'adapt' expectation rests on; e2e/creative-routing.spec.ts re-verifies every anchor against the CURRENT catalog before the table is trusted (the brief-bank decay rule, plan §1.3). Routing runs are scripts/creative-route-bench.mjs (SPENDS TOKENS). An 'either' brief that resolves the same way across every benched model is a candidate for tightening into a real expectation at the next bank revision (§11 criterion 1); three were tightened to 'adapt' on 2026-07-30, leaving 27 scored briefs (8 lower third / 11 versus / 8 bracket) and 2 'either'.
